info.title: Qingniao gateway
info.description: Loopback gateway for Claude Code with a shared connection catalog and per-instance routing. Only the endpoints below are implemented; request bodies are forwarded with only the model field rewritten, and streaming (SSE) responses are relayed chunk by chunk with content encodings decoded.

servers.description: Loopback only; the port is published in the state directory discovery file (gateway.json, 0600)

controlToken.description: Per-run control token from the discovery file. Instance tokens are rejected with 403 instance_token_not_admin.

instanceToken.description: Per-instance token delivered only in the registration response. Unknown or stale tokens (including after a gateway restart) fail with 401 invalid_instance_token.

errors_.description: Present on invalid_config: field paths and messages.

base_url.description: API root; http/https, no userinfo, query or fragment. /v1/... paths are appended at forwarding time.

credential_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the credential in the gateway process. Exactly one of credential_env or credential_id must be present. Values are never stored.

credential_id.description: Id of an immutable version in the private credential store (credentials/ directory, 0700/0600). Exactly one of credential_env or credential_id must be present. The secret value never appears in the configuration.

Provider.description: A provider connection with exactly one credential source: an environment variable read from the gateway process or a private credential version created by an import.

model.description: Default main request model; must be a routes key when set.

aux_model.description: Default auxiliary request model; must be a routes key when set.

routes.description: Exact request model string -> catalog model ID.

schema_version.description: Explicit format version. Absent means the legacy format on input; responses always carry 1.

generation.description: Persistent monotonic write counter; 0 means not yet written in format version 1. Use it as expected_generation for conditional writes.

last_operation.description: Id of the most recent import transaction that committed this configuration, when any.

SharedConfig.description: The shared configuration. Requests may carry the legacy format without schema_version (environment-variable credentials only); responses and every persisted write use format version 1 with an explicit generation. Unknown future versions are rejected, never migrated or overwritten.

catalog_present.description: False once the catalog entry was edited or deleted after this snapshot was taken.

credential_id.description: Private credential id, present when the snapshot references the private store instead of an environment variable.

model.description: Main request model; null or omitted defaults to defaults.model.

aux_model.description: Auxiliary request model; null or omitted defaults to defaults.aux_model.

routes.description: Exact request model -> catalog model ID overrides merged over defaults.routes; null or omitted uses defaults.routes.

InstanceCreateRequest.description: Unknown properties are ignored by the runtime.

model.description: Catalog model ID resolved from the current catalog.

expected_revision.description: Compare-and-swap guard; must equal the instance's current revision.

RouteSetRequest.description: Unknown properties are ignored by the runtime.

model.description: Exact request model string; matched against the instance's routes, never rewritten client-side.

ProxyMessageRequest.description: The gateway performs no Anthropic payload validation beyond requiring a model string; all other fields are forwarded unchanged (with the model field replaced by the snapshot's upstream model). stream may be true (responses are relayed chunk by chunk) or false/absent (buffered relay).

UpstreamRelay.description: An upstream response body relayed verbatim: arbitrary structure, schema and content type. The gateway does not interpret, validate or translate upstream payloads. An upstream body may coincidentally match the Error shape; shape alone does not classify a response as gateway-generated.

RequestRecord.description: Bounded, sanitized request metadata. No request/response bodies, tool arguments, credentials, raw exceptions or upstream error payloads are stored. Usage values are null when unknown; real zeros are preserved.

operation_id.description: Client-generated operation id; repeating it with the same plan returns the original result, a different plan is rejected.

plan.description: Complete wire-encoded import plan produced by 'qing config import-claude'. May carry the secret for the private store; the body is never logged and errors never echo it.

provider_id.description: Provider the import wrote, when it wrote one.

credential_id.description: Private credential id (an id, never the secret).

applied.description: True only when the running gateway swapped it in.

duplicate.description: True when an earlier identical operation already completed.

ImportResult.description: Sanitized import outcome; never contains secret material.

OperationStatus.description: Operation query result: id, commit status and generation only.

generation.description: Persisted configuration generation (0 for a legacy or absent file).

put.description: Resolves the destination from the current catalog and atomically replaces that route snapshot; the acknowledgement is returned only after the gateway applied the change. Requests already admitted keep the previous snapshot.

200.description: Applied acknowledgement with the new revision

post.description: Forward an Anthropic messages request. Authenticates the instance, matches the body model exactly against the instance's routes, captures the immutable route snapshot at admission, then forwards with only the model field rewritten and the provider credential injected. The client's own Authorization/x-api-key are never forwarded. Query strings (e.g. ?beta=true) are preserved. Non-streaming bodies are relayed buffered; stream:true responses are relayed chunk by chunk with content encodings (e.g. gzip) decoded by the gateway, so downstream always receives identity-encoded SSE with intact event and usage semantics. No retries, no redirects, no model fallback.

200.description: Upstream response relayed verbatim (status and body)

default.description: Any upstream status code and body relayed verbatim. The gateway does not interpret or translate upstream error payloads.

502.description: Either a gateway-generated error (upstream_error; Error schema with a stable code) or an upstream 502 response relayed verbatim (arbitrary body, schema and content type, no stable code).
